vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: compound-eng-file-todos
Version: 2.53.0

The skill bundle provides a structured system for file-based todo tracking using Markdown files in a dedicated directory. All instructions in SKILL.md and workflows.md are aligned with the stated purpose of task management, and the provided bash commands in quick-reference.md are standard file operations (ls, grep, mv) restricted to the local workspace.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only, local file-based todo workflow that only reads/edits markdown files under a todos/ directory and does not request credentials or install code — its claims match its instructions.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (file-based todo management) align with the provided files and instructions: templates, naming conventions, workflows, and shell snippets all relate to creating, triaging, listing, and managing markdown todo files. The only minor note is references to integrations (gh CLI, slash commands) which are described but not required by the skill; this is reasonable as optional integration guidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs reading and modifying files in the todos/ directory (cp, mv, grep, ls, etc.) which is exactly the stated purpose. It assumes standard Unix CLI utilities exist but does not declare them as required; this is typical but worth noting. There are no instructions to read unrelated system paths or exfiltrate data to external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. This is the lowest-risk install model (nothing written to disk by the skill).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no environment variables or credentials and none are needed for the core file-based workflows. The docs mention optional integrations (e.g., gh CLI, review agents) that would require separate credentials or tooling if you choose to use them; those are not requested by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and disable-model-invocation is true, so the skill will not be autonomously invoked by the model and is not forced into every agent run. The skill does not request persistent presence or attempt to modify other skills or system-wide configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This is an instruction-only, local workflow for managing markdown todos — overall low risk. Before using: back up your todos/ directory if you care about existing files, because the workflows include rename/mv and grep commands; ensure you have standard shell utilities (ls, grep, mv, cp) if you plan to run the examples. If you plan to integrate with GitHub (gh CLI) or slash-command workflows, be aware those integrations require separate tooling and credentials that this skill does not request or manage. Because disable-model-invocation is true, the skill will not run autonomously — you'll invoke these instructions manually or via your own tooling.
